newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-BRANN IMPRESSED, BUT DOES NOT FEAR LIVERPOOL. [CORRECTED 13:58 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRANN IMPRESSED, BUT DOES NOT FEAR LIVERPOOL. [CORRECTED 13:58 GMT]

text.p: Brann soccer coach Kjell Tennfjord is optimistic over the Norwegians' chances when they meet Liverpool at Anfield Road for the second leg of their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final on March 20, was quoted as saying on Tuesday.
The premier league team held Liverpool to a 1-1 draw in the first leg in the west coast city of Bergen on March 6.

"I am cautiously optimistic for the return match," Tennfjord told the tabloid Verdens Gang but praised Liverpool for their 4-3 English premier league win over Newcastle on Monday (corrects by inserting dropped words). "Liverpool were clearly the best, but it was proved again that they can be vulnerable in defence."
Tennfjord said he was undecided what formation he would play for the away match, but it would be either 4-4-2 or 4-4-1-1.
